mapper.update: update player_result_activityid${l} set round_index=${index} where player_id=#{uid} and activity_id=#{activityId}
mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, activity_id AS activityId, content AS content, level AS level, end_date AS endDate, name as name FROM t_free_game_result WHERE activity_id IN ( SELECT activity_id FROM t_activity_user u WHERE u.userid = #{userId} ) ORDER BY end_date DESC limit 0,10

SELECT fgr.id AS id, fgr.activity_id AS activityId, fgr.content AS content, fgr.level AS level, fgr.end_date AS endDate, fgr.name as name FROM t_free_game_result fgr, t_activity a WHERE a.owner_id = #{userId} and a.status = 2 and a.activity_id = fgr.activity_id ORDER BY fgr.end_date DESC limit 0,10
select ifnull(round_index,0) from player_result_activityid${l} where player_id=#{uid} and activity_id=#{activityId}
select ifnull(round_index,0) from t_free_game_result where activity_id=#{activityId}
